question: A train crosses a telegraph post and a bridge of length 300 metres in 10 seconds and 20 seconds, respectively. Find the speed of the train.
solution:
Given:

Length of the bridge = 300 m.

Time taken to cross the bridge = 20 sec.

Time taken to cross the post = 10 sec.

Formula used:

Speed = Distance covered/ime taken

Calculation:

Let the length of the train = y m 

To crosses the bridge train need to cover = Train's length + Bridge length = (y + 300)

Now, the Speed of the train is the same in both cases

⇒ y/10 = (300 + y)/20

⇒ 2y = 300 + y

⇒ 2y - y = 300

⇒ y = 300 m. 

Length of the train = 300 m

Speed of the train = 300/10 = 30 m/sec = (30 × 18)/5 = 108 Kmph

∴ The Speed of the train is 108 kmph
